description: Browse and update Jira Data Center issues from BB, and let agents change them only after you approve. Open a list or status board, edit fields in place, and drag a card through the workflow. Agents can search, create, edit, transition, comment on, assign, and delete issues, with each write kind asking first unless you set it to always allow. Link a BB project to its Jira projects so chats stay scoped, spawn a thread from an issue, or drive the same actions with bb jira-dc. Requires a reachable Jira Data Center (or Server) base URL and a Personal Access Token; Jira Cloud is not supported.
